Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Sen,

Thank you for meeting us on 16 March 2022 about your dispute with Joseph Tiwari. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Coimbatore.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 22,40,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Coimbatore
